The '''home''' of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]] sat high in the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|searched]] by some [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="hs" />
